answer: To resist Sybil attacks in an AI agent economy, agents must periodically query a shared beacon that broadcasts unique epoch seeds. Each agent then generates a cryptographic thread linking its prior actions to the current seed, sealed with an opal-hard zero-knowledge proof of unique compute. Attackers incur high costs because forging many consistent threads requires proportional real-time computation and stake that scales linearly with the number of fake identities, making mass creation economically prohibitive.
